notes: Preset multipliers apply to product print_hours and filament_g, and to the printer's fail chance. Durability and quality are 1 to 5. Product difficulty and printer quality can shift final quality by +/-1.

durability_scale.1: Fragile. Snaps easily, high chance of transit damage.
durability_scale.2: Light duty. Fine for decor, risky for anything handled.
durability_scale.3: Normal. Survives everyday use and most deliveries.
durability_scale.4: Tough. Good for functional parts and B2B.
durability_scale.5: Very tough. Almost never breaks in transit.

presets.name: Draft
presets.description: Quick and cheap. Fine for test prints and stuff nobody looks at closely.

presets.name: Standard
presets.description: The sensible default. Good looks, decent strength.

presets.name: Strong
presets.description: Built like a brick. Takes longer and uses more filament, but survives the post.

presets.name: Fine detail
presets.description: Silky smooth surfaces for figurines and display pieces. Slow.

presets.name: Vase mode
presets.description: One continuous spiral wall. Super fast for vases and lamp shades, but hollow and fragile.
presets.real_settings_tooltip: Single spiral wall, no top, no infill

presets.name: Speed run
presets.description: Pushes the printer to its limit. Great on fast machines, risky on slow ones.
presets.real_settings_tooltip: 0.24 mm layers, 3 walls, 15% infill, max speed

presets.name: Production
presets.description: Tuned for batches: balanced strength, consistent results, low fail rate.
presets.real_settings_tooltip: 0.20 mm layers, 4 walls, 20% infill, slower outer wall

toggles.name: Supports: off
toggles.description: No supports. Saves time and plastic, but overhangs may collapse.
toggles.notes: Overhanging designs roll support_failure with x4 weight

toggles.name: Supports: normal
toggles.description: Grid supports under overhangs. Leaves marks to clean up.

toggles.name: Supports: tree
toggles.description: Branching supports. Less plastic, cleaner removal.

toggles.name: Brim
toggles.description: Extra rim around the base to stop warping and lifting.

toggles.name: Multicolour
toggles.description: Use the product's full colours. Needs a multicolour unit, IDEX or toolchanger.

effects.purge_waste: from products.json purge_waste_g, scaled by the unit's purge_g_per_swap

toggles.notes: Off = print in one colour. Sells for 30% less and some buyers leave lower reviews

toggles.name: Ironing
toggles.description: Smooths flat top surfaces with a second pass.

toggles.name: Fill the plate
toggles.description: Print as many copies as fit on the bed at once.

effects.print_time_mult: 0.85 per copy vs printing them one at a time

toggles.notes: Copies all fail together if the plate fails
